info.title: Gathr API
info.description:
# Gathr Crowdfunding Platform API

A production-grade crowdfunding backend API built with NestJS.

## Features
- User authentication with JWT
- Gathr post management (offers & requests)
- Donation processing
- Wallet & payout management
- Real-time notifications
- Admin dashboard

## Authentication
Most endpoints require authentication. Use the **Authorize** button above to add your JWT token.

### Getting Started
1. Register a new account: `POST /api/v1/auth/register`
2. Login: `POST /api/v1/auth/login`
3. Use the returned access token in the Authorization header

## Rate Limiting
- 100 requests per minute per IP
- Higher limits for authenticated users
